summary: Estimo Phase 1 full stack tested end-to-end. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass — health, DVF status (110 213 sales across 41/37/45), BAN geocoding (Blois covered, Paris uncovered), property CRUD, estimation (appartement Blois returned ~132 k€ with value/low<value<high, price_m2, confidence.score 76 level 'eleve', 3 market levels, comparables ≤30), maison land adjustment present, remote address triggers radius widening / insufficient_data flag, surface=5 -> 422, reestimate updates estimation, soft delete removes from list and returns 404 on GET, unknown id 404, validation report includes n/mape/median_ape/coverage/by_confidence/results. Frontend (Expo web, 390x844): Home shows property cards with range 'k€ – k€' + confidence badge + FAB + home-data-button; /data shows dvf-status-card with dvf-total '110 213 ventes' and dvf-dept-41/37/45 rows, validation-run-button produced validation-results within ~5 s; /new wizard passed all 3 steps (address-input -> address-result-0 -> address-selected -> step-continue-button; type-segment-appartement/maison, surface-input, rooms-stepper-plus, bedrooms-stepper-plus; year-input, condition-segment-bon, summary-card, estimate-submit-button); /property/{id} showed estimation-range, estimation-value, confidence-badge; view-comparables-button navigated to comparable-row-0; reestimate-button and delete flow (delete-button -> delete-confirm-button) returned to home. No console errors beyond a single React Native web deprecation warning about shadow* -> boxShadow.

issues: Minor: React Native Web console warning 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' (non-blocking, cosmetic)

action_items: Optional: migrate `shadow*` StyleSheet properties to `boxShadow` on the FAB (app/index.tsx) and other shadowed containers to silence the React Native Web deprecation warning.
Optional: consider adding a 'radius_label' or notes assertion in a UI regression test to confirm the widening message renders on remote addresses.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L193: `@app.on_event('startup')` is deprecated in FastAPI 0.109+; consider migrating to lifespan handlers (not blocking).
estimator.py L44: haversine constant + logic is fine; math well-scoped. No issues.
server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id via PropertyDoc.from_mongo alias; no ObjectId leaks in responses (verified in test).
All frontend interactive elements carry testID; env vars used correctly (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST-prefixed properties and clean them up in teardown. Remote Loiret test case may leave 1 property when the estimation succeeds; auto-cleanup runs at teardown_class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_estimo_backend.py and can be rerun with `pytest backend/tests/test_estimo_backend.py -v`. DVF ingestion already present (110 213 rows) — do NOT trigger POST /api/dvf/ingest. BAN geocoder occasionally returns empty for very partial queries; use full street-city queries like '1 rue denis papin blois'. Property detail sub-cards (confidence-breakdown, adjustments-card, market-card) fade-in with 180–300 ms delays; wait ~400 ms after navigation before asserting visibility.
